data.name: Street Light Simulator 2026
data.detailed_description:
Street Lamp Simulator 2026 is a minimalist ambient simulation that follows your computer's real-world clock. As day turns to night where you are, the street lamp illuminates the scene, creating a calm atmosphere to accompany work, studying, relaxing, or simply taking a quiet moment.

There are no objectives, scores, or progression systems. Instead, the experience is designed to exist alongside your day, quietly reflecting the passage of time.

Features

  • Real-world system clock synchronization

  • Dynamic day and night lighting

  • Minimalist ambient experience

  • Designed for relaxing, studying, or background ambience

  • Simple controls

Controls

  • Press Spacebar to exit.
